description: Instinct-based learning system for OpenClaw. Analyzes sessions, detects patterns, creates atomic learnings with confidence scoring, and suggests optimizations for self-evolution. Works alongside agent-self-improvement for complete learning: internal session analysis + external user feedback. Use when: you want your AI agent to learn from its own behavior, improve over time, discover optimization opportunities, or build a self-improving automation system. Don't use when: static agent behavior is preferred.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
